name: Edit, revise & improve
instruction: Edit, revise, and improve the selected text. Keep my meaning and concrete details, make it clearer and more fluent, and avoid making it sound overly polished or corporate.

name: Proofread with minimal changes
instruction: Correct spelling, grammar, punctuation, and clear usage errors in the selected text. Preserve the wording, structure, tone, and meaning wherever a change is not necessary.

name: Shorten without losing meaning
instruction: Shorten the selected text by removing repetition and unnecessary wording. Preserve its main point, important facts, qualifications, and requested actions.

name: Draft a reply
instruction: Treat the selected text as a message I received and draft a natural, appropriately concise reply. Address the important points and do not invent facts, commitments, dates, or attachments.
